subject: science

sections.scope_note: Arizona standards deferred per Ivan (2026-10-03). This crosswalk covers Florida NGSSS Science ↔ IB PYP Science only.

rows.key_differences: Florida specifies raising questions, comparing observations across groups, and keeping records. PYP frames inquiry as fundamental to all learning through the Inquirer learner profile.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Structure science investigations using the PYP inquiry cycle—tuning in, finding out, sorting out, going further—while explicitly teaching Florida's scientific method requirements.

rows.key_differences: Florida emphasizes communication among scientists and peer review of evidence. PYP develops communication as an approach to learning across all subjects.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Include peer review protocols in science investigations where students question, discuss, and check each other's explanations, building both scientific and communication skills.

rows.topic_domain: Nature of Science - Evidence and Inference
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies inference from observation and understanding empirical evidence. PYP develops critical thinking and causation across transdisciplinary learning.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Use 'What do you notice? What do you wonder? What's your evidence?' routines to develop inference skills, connecting observations to causal explanations.

rows.topic_domain: Nature of Science - Models and Scientific Language
rows.key_differences: Florida requires understanding scientific vocabulary and that models are approximations. PYP uses the concept of 'form' to understand representations.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Build class scientific vocabulary walls and use multiple models (drawings, physical, digital) for the same phenomenon, discussing what each model shows well and what it misses.

rows.topic_domain: Earth and Space - Stars and the Sun
ib_framework_elements: PYP Transdisciplinary Theme: Where we are in place and time
PYP Science: Earth and space strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies star characteristics, Sun as energy source, and telescope observations. PYP explores Earth's place in space through 'Where we are in place and time'.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Design a 'Where we are in place and time' unit on space, investigating star differences and the Sun's role while connecting to students' place in the universe.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Forces and energy strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies exploring gravity as a force that can be overcome. PYP examines forces through the concept of function—how does gravity work?
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Conduct hands-on gravity experiments (ramps, parachutes, rockets) exploring how gravity functions and can be overcome, connecting to both standards and conceptual understanding.

rows.topic_domain: Earth Science - Heat and Energy from the Sun
ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Forces and energy strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies demonstrating radiant energy heating and cooling. PYP explores causation—why do things heat and cool?
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Set up solar heating investigations—comparing temperatures in sun vs. shade, exploring what happens when energy source is removed—building causal understanding.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Materials and matter strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies measuring temperature, mass, volume and comparing properties. PYP explores the form of materials—what is matter like?
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Create a materials investigation center where students measure and compare properties, building both measurement skills and conceptual understanding of matter's forms.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Materials and matter strand
rows.key_differences: Florida requires describing water's state changes using scientific terms. PYP examines change as a key concept.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Investigate water's transformations through hands-on experiments, using scientific vocabulary while exploring the broader concept of how matter changes.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Forces and energy strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies identifying energy forms and recognizing energy causes motion/change. PYP explores how energy functions.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Create an energy museum with stations for light, heat, sound, electrical, and mechanical energy, exploring how each form functions to cause motion or change.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Forces and energy strand
PYP Transdisciplinary Theme: How the world works
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies light traveling in straight lines and being reflected/refracted/absorbed. PYP investigates how the world works through energy investigations.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Design light investigations with mirrors, prisms, and various materials, exploring how light behaves as part of a 'How the world works' unit.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Science: Forces and energy strand
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies light producing heat and friction producing heat. PYP explores connections between energy forms.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Investigate energy connections—light bulbs that heat, rubbing hands to warm—building understanding of how energy forms connect and transform.

rows.topic_domain: Life Science - Plant Structures and Functions
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies plant structures, functions, and responses to stimuli. PYP explores living things through form and function concepts.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Grow plants in classroom investigations, observing structures, functions (photosynthesis, support, reproduction), and responses to light and gravity.

rows.topic_domain: Life Science - Animal and Plant Classification
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies classifying animals by major groups and plants by flowering/nonflowering. PYP examines living things' forms.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Create classification systems for local animals and plants, discovering grouping criteria through inquiry while building toward Florida's specified categories.

ib_framework_elements: PYP Transdisciplinary Theme: Sharing the planet
rows.key_differences: Florida specifies seasonal responses and photosynthesis. PYP explores interdependence through 'Sharing the planet' theme.
rows.suggested_instructional_bridge: Design a 'Sharing the planet' unit on ecosystems, investigating how plants and animals depend on each other and respond to seasonal changes.
